title: Retrieve a Self Assessment Tax Liability Summary

metadata.description: Object containing top-level metadata information about the retrieved tax liability summary.

calculationId.description: The unique identifier of the calculation. Must conform to the regular expression: `^[0-9]{8}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

taxYear.description: The tax year in which the calculation was performed. Tax year in the format `YYYY-YY`.

calculationReason.description:
The reason why the calculation was triggered. Limited to one of the following possible values:

* **customer-request** - The calculation was triggered by the customer via software.

* **class2-nic-event** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC once the actual Class 2 NIC amount became available.

* **new-annual-adjustment-event** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC on receipt of a request for a new adjustable summary calculation by the customer. This event is not currently supported.

* **updated-annual-adjustment-event** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC on receipt of an adjustment to an adjustable summary calculation made by the customer. This event is not currently supported.

* **unattended-calculation** - HMRC has updated the calculation for you. You can see more details in your record-keeping software.

* **enquiry-amendment** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC following a Revenue Amendment made as part of an enquiry.

* **auto-correction** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC following an automatic correction made to the customer's submission.

* **manual-correction** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC following a manual correction made to the customer's submission.

* **marriage-allowance** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC following an update to the customer's Marriage Allowance.

* **class2-national-insurance** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC following an update to the customer's Class 2 National Insurance Contributions (NICs).

* **devolved-residency** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC following an update to the customer's devolved residency information.

* **customer-rejection-of-a-correction** - The calculation was triggered internally by HMRC following a customer's rejection of a correction made to their submission.

calculationTimestamp.description: The timestamp of when the calculation was performed in ISO 8601 UTC format: `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

taxRegime.description: The tax regime which applies to this calculation.
